requirements.title: Nonassociated pointers are not referenced or defined
requirements.definition: A pointer whose association status is not associated is outside the conforming source boundary for reference or definition. This restriction is about pointer association status, not target value, declaration syntax or target lifetime.

pending.associated-reference-control: PENDING positive control: create a TARGET integer with value 41, pointer-assign p => target, read p into sentinel -7 and expect 41; the source-boundary contrast removes only the pointer assignment and is not executed.
pending.associated-definition-control: PENDING positive control: associate p with a TARGET integer initialized to -9, assign p = 23, then check the target value 23; the source-boundary contrast removes only association before definition and is not executed.
pending.nonassociated-source-boundary: PENDING source-use inventory links future invalid examples to this restriction only after separating declaration, association status and target lifetime owners; no diagnostic is required by this unnumbered shall.

requirements.oracle: Positive controls establish associated status before every reference or definition and use distinct integer sentinels. The nonassociated variant is a source-boundary contrast only.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Executing a nonassociated pointer reference or definition would be a nonconforming program, and this unnumbered shall does not require a processor diagnostic. Crashes, traps, stale target values and diagnostic text are not portable evidence.
requirements.dependencies: 19.5.2.2 defines association status; 10.2.2.3 and 10.2.2.4 define pointer assignment effects; 16.9 ASSOCIATED can observe defined association status; target lifetime rules remain with Clause 19 and procedure association catalogues.

accounting.rationale: Defines the three pointer association statuses and cross-references 19.5.2.2. Initial status, status changes and inquiry details stay with the pointer-association catalogues.
Defines that pointer array rank is declared while bounds come from target association. Pointer assignment and bounds-remapping obligations are owned by 10.2.2.3.

review_rationale: Source registration for 5.4.7-5.4.11 and 5.5-5.5.7 of the Clause 5 overview (batch250). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; restated rules are cross-referenced to their owning catalogues, R516 had no existing tests, and processor-dependent text is latitude. Source accounting only.
